build_light_gnn_model: build a light GNN model for training NeuralLNS with configurable layers and dropout
create_adjacency_matrix: create an adjacency matrix sparse tensor from a graph tuple with senders and receivers
encode_graph_nodes: encode graph nodes through stacked LightGNN layers with adjacency matrix propagation
run_greedy_sample: run greedy sampling on graph nodes to produce binary samples and probabilities
predict_node_logits: predict logits for selected graph nodes using the output MLP layer
